summary.text: Melissa Nikolakakos is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 20 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator by career, she serves on the House Education, House Taxation, and Agriculture committees.

paragraphs.text: Melissa Nikolakakos' career experience includes working as an educator.
She has served as a pre-school president, a Girl Scout Service Unit Leader, and a PTA president.
Nikolakakos defeated Rina Fontana Moore in the November 5, 2024 general election and assumed office on January 6, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Education, House Taxation, and Agriculture committees.
